sentences.text: Not to be confused with the Canadian musician , Drake .	Drake	Drake (musician)
Jared Drake Bell -LRB- born June 27 , 1986 -RRB- is an American actor , voice actor , and musician .	Drake	Drake (musician)

Born in Newport Beach , California , he began his career as an actor in the early 1990s at the age of five with his first televised appearance on Home Improvement .	Home Improvement	Home Improvement (TV series)

Bell also appeared in several commercials , such as one for Pokémon Red and Blue , but is best known for his starring roles on Nickelodeon 's The Amanda Show , and its spin-off , Drake & Josh .	Drake	Drake (musician)	Nickelodeon	Nickelodeon	The Amanda Show	The Amanda Show	Drake & Josh	Drake & Josh
Bell starred in a trilogy of The Fairly OddParents movies on Nickelodeon .	Nickelodeon	Nickelodeon	The Fairly OddParents	The Fairly OddParents

Bell was the voice of Peter Parker / Spider-Man in the animated series Ultimate Spider-Man on Disney XD .	Peter Parker / Spider-Man	Spider-Man	Ultimate Spider-Man	Ultimate Spider-Man (TV series)	Disney XD	Disney XD
He appeared on ABC 's reality TV series Splash .	Splash	Splash (TV series)

In addition to acting , Bell has a career in music starting in the early 2000s , at the time of his appearances on The Amanda Show , with a band named Drake 24/7 .	Drake	Drake (musician)	The Amanda Show	The Amanda Show
He also co-wrote and performed the theme song to Drake & Josh , entitled `` Found a Way . ''	Drake	Drake (musician)	Drake & Josh	Drake & Josh	Found a Way	Found a Way
In 2005 he independently released his debut album , Telegraph , released under Bell 's own name .	Telegraph	Telegraph (album)

His second album , It 's Only Time , was released in 2006 after signing with Universal Motown Records and debuted at # 81 on the Billboard 200 , selling over 23,000 copies its first week of release .	Universal Motown	Universal Motown Records	Universal Motown Records	Universal Motown Records
It 's Only Time has sold 178,000 copies in the United States as of 2012 .
His first video album , Drake Bell In Concert , was released in 2008 .	Drake	Drake (musician)	Drake Bell In Concert	Drake Bell In Concert
It debuted at # 81 on the Top 100 Mexican Albums Chart .
Bell released an EP in 2011 called A Reminder independently .	A Reminder	A Reminder
In 2014 , Bell released his third album , Ready Steady Go !
under indie label Surfdog Records .	Surfdog	Surfdog Records	Surfdog Records	Surfdog Records
debuted at # 182 on the Billboard 200 , and sold 2,000 copies in its first week of release .
